plan: [In a sealed-bid second-price auction, bidding my true value is a dominant strategy: if I win I pay the second-highest bid, so revealing $30 maximizes expected profit regardless of others. [This is a second-price (Vickrey) sealed-bid auction with independent private values. Bidding your true value is a dominant strategy: you win when the second-highest bid is below your value and pay that second price, maximizing expected profit. There’s no useful gain from shading or overbidding. My private value is $7, so I will bid my true value to maximize long-run expected profit.]

[In a second-price sealed-bid auction, bidding your true private value is a dominant strategy: it maximizes expected profit regardless of others' strategies. Bidding lower risks losing positive-profit wins; bidding higher risks negative payoff. Given my value is $36 and bids are in $0.1 increments, I will bid $36. ]
